overall: The AG found no violation: the Board discussed two individuals in open session and not in executive session, so no notice to those individuals was required. The AG added a reminder to list complaint reviews as meeting topics when anticipated more than 48 hours ahead.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed the reputation and character of two individuals at a February open meeting without giving those individuals notice.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body provide notice to individuals it may discuss during a meeting, unless its discussion will occur during executive session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(1).
